title: A blank draft and a positive spin

stories.headline: COP31 climate talks end without a deal
Trump sees a positive spin in a reported FBI hack

beats.narr: The UN climate talks in Turkey ended on Sunday.
The final draft said nothing on moving away from fossil fuels.
The talks ran two days into overtime: the longest COP on record.
No deal was agreed.

n261122a.end: Rick has claimed the overtime. Nobody else wanted it.
n261122a.title: Rick wins the overtime
n261122a.claim: The COP31 UN climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, ended on Sunday without a deal, after the EU and others rejected a final text with no reference to moving away from fossil fuels.
n261122a.why: COP decisions need every country's consent. These talks ran two days into overtime, the longest COP on record; the last to fail like this was Copenhagen, in 2009.
facts: Ran 2 days into overtime: the longest COP on record
Kurum: "There is nothing to do, we did all that we could"
Kurum later left the stage while countries spoke
Bowen called the outcome "very disappointing"
Draft goal: electricity 35% of world energy by 2035
Ireland's minister: "hijacked by some oil states"

beats.narr: The climate talks in Antalya were meant to end in a deal.
The draft set a goal: electricity at 35% of world energy by 2035.
It said nothing on moving away from fossil fuels. The EU and others said no.
Its president, Murat Kurum, said they did all they could. He later left the stage.

n261122b.end: The chair is still for sale. One careful owner. Left early.

beats.narr: An FBI crime database has reportedly been hacked.
Donald Trump was asked about it on Fox News.
He said he always likes to put things on a positive spin.
"Maybe we'll learn things," he said.

n261122e.end: Posy is taking a short break to find the positive in this.
n261122e.title: Posy is out-encouraged
n261122e.claim: Donald Trump told Fox News on Saturday that a reported hack of an FBI crime database could have a positive spin, because "maybe we'll learn things".
n261122e.why: The National Crime Information Center holds FBI fingerprint records and wanted persons. It is for police use, not classified, and it is unclear what data was taken.
facts: Trump: "I always like to put things on a positive spin"
Said on Saturday, November 21, to Fox News

beats.narr: Mauricio Pochettino took charge of Manchester United for the first time.
A United defender was sent off after 8 minutes.
Liverpool won 4-0.
United have 8 points from 11 games.

n261122g.end: Rick has retracted two takes. A third is in the post.
n261122g.title: Rick's take: best hire ever, for 8 minutes
n261122g.claim: Mauricio Pochettino's first match as Manchester United manager ended in a 4-0 defeat at Liverpool, after defender Leny Yoro was sent off after eight minutes.
n261122g.why: United played with 10 men for more than 80 minutes. They have won one league game all season, in August, and are in the relegation zone.
facts: Final score at Anfield: Liverpool 4, United 0
Yoro sent off after 8 minutes

beats.narr: The new Hunger Games film opened this weekend.
It took $120 million at the domestic box office.
For a prequel, that is the second-best opening, behind Rogue One.

n261122h.end: A reliable source confirms it was second. The other one.
n261122h.title: EXCLUSIVE: the biggest second place ever
n261122h.claim: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to $120 million at the domestic box office and $225 million worldwide, Gizmodo reported, citing Variety.
n261122h.why: It is the sixth film in the series. Its domestic start is the second best ever for a prequel, behind Rogue One's $155 million in 2016.
facts: Domestic opening: $120 million
Worldwide opening: $225 million
Best prequel start: Rogue One, $155 million
Last prequel, 2023: $100.8 million worldwide
The sixth film in the series
Critics "mixed"; fans "high on it"

beats.narr: Two linked spacecraft reached orbit around Mercury on Saturday.
The trip took eight years, with six flybys of Mercury on the way.
Mercury can reach more than 800 degrees Fahrenheit.

n261122i.end: Mercury has been told it is second hottest in the studio.
n261122i.title: Vavoom finds Mercury lukewarm
n261122i.claim: BepiColombo, a pair of linked European and Japanese spacecraft, slipped into orbit around Mercury on Saturday after an eight-year cruise.
n261122i.why: It is only the third spacecraft to visit Mercury, and the first in more than a decade. The two craft will separate next month to map the planet.
facts: Launched in 2018; cost $2 billion
Flew past Mercury 6 times before orbit
Mercury can top 800 degrees F (427 C)
Controllers in Germany, 94 million miles away
Over 6 billion miles on the odometer
Scientist: kept "as cool as possible"

beats.narr: Actor Bruce Campbell now holds a U.S. patent.
It is for a Do Not Disturb door sign.
It will not easily fall off the door handle.
Its aim, he says, is more sleep while travelling.

n261122j.end: The motion to sleep was carried. Gary is still knocking.
n261122j.title: Point of order: the sign stays up
n261122j.claim: Actor Bruce Campbell now holds U.S. Patent no. 12,776,232, for a Do Not Disturb door sign that will not easily fall off the door handle.
n261122j.why: Perforated plastic flanges help hold the sign in place. Campbell hopes the improvement may help him get more sleep while travelling.
